svg.title: Two strips of 127 marks each, for magnitude and random pruning, at 50, 75 and 90% of the input weights zeroed. The magnitude marks stay near r = 1 longer. The random marks spread down towards 0.
svg.text: As more weights go, magnitude pruning keeps each
pole's activations, and random pruning does not
Each mark is one pole: Pearson's r between its activations before and after pruning,
on 20,000 tokens of web text. The frames step through the pruning levels.
Pearson's r with the unpruned activations
